saints.name: St. John
saints.title: Apostle and Evangelist
saints.shortBlurb: The beloved disciple who leaned on the Lord's breast, stood by the Cross, and wrote the fourth Gospel…
biography: John, son of Zebedee and brother of James, was among the first called and one of the three closest to the Lord. He is “the disciple whom Jesus loved,” who leaned upon His breast at the Supper, stood by the Cross to receive His mother, and was first to believe at the empty tomb.
Tradition ascribes to him the fourth Gospel, three Epistles, and the Apocalypse, and holds that he lived to great age at Ephesus — the only Apostle not to die a martyr.
saints.knownFor: The beloved disciple; author of the fourth Gospel.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 27 December
